VectorScene and LinearTransformationScene

Source: R/vector_space_scene.R
VectorScene.Rd

Scenes for linear algebra. VectorScene adds helpers to draw planes, vectors, labels and coordinates. LinearTransformationScene sets up a background plane, a transformable foreground plane and basis vectors, then animates matrices with apply_matrix(), apply_transposed_matrix(), apply_inverse() and apply_nonlinear_transformation().

Shear <- R6::R6Class("Shear", inherit = LinearTransformationScene,
  public = list(construct = function() {
    self$add_unit_square()
    self$apply_matrix(matrix(c(1, 0, 1, 1), 2))
    self$wait()
  }))

Usage

X_COLOR

Y_COLOR

Z_COLOR

Details

VectorScene$new() and LinearTransformationScene$new() take basis_vector_stroke_width, the stroke width of the basis vectors. LinearTransformationScene$new() also takes include_background_plane and include_foreground_plane, which planes to draw; background_plane_kwargs and foreground_plane_kwargs, lists of NumberPlane() arguments; show_coordinates, to label the background plane; show_basis_vectors, to draw i hat and j hat; i_hat_color and j_hat_color, the colors of the basis vectors; and leave_ghost_vectors, to keep faded copies of vectors after each transformation. Other arguments are passed to Scene.

X_COLOR, Y_COLOR and Z_COLOR are the default colors of the x, y and z basis vectors.
